product_name: SanDisk Extreme SD UHS-I 128GB Card for 4K Video for DSLR and Mirrorless Cameras 180MB/s Read & 90MB/s Write
features: Durable design for use in demanding shooting conditions
about_this_item: Up to 180MB/s read speeds and up to 90MB/s write speeds for fast file transfers and high-speed shooting.
Capture 4K UHD video with UHS Speed Class 3 (U3) and Video Speed Class 30 (V30) performance.
Built for DSLR and mirrorless cameras and suitable for high-resolution photography and video.
Durable and designed to withstand demanding conditions, including water, temperature extremes, shocks, X-rays and magnets.
Available in capacities up to 1TB, providing ample storage for photos and video.
